title: Operational knowledge update v3
description: A reviewable operational-learning disposition with stable component identity and forward freshness deadlines. Version 3 adds the required freshness object (review_at and expires_at, either of which may be null) to the version 2 shape; component identity, triggers, evidence, dispositions, recommendation, and safety definitions remain anchored in the immutable v1 and v2 schemas. The bundled validator additionally enforces that a stated deadline is later than created_at and that review_at never falls after expires_at, alongside evidence-label monotonicity, reference integrity, caller-authorized knowledge roots, safe repository paths, trigger-specific coverage, exact Git-reviewable changes, lifecycle deferral, and structured credential rejection.

freshness.description: Forward review and expiry deadlines for this packet's knowledge claim. Either field may be null when no cadence was set; neither is inferred by migration. The bundled validator rejects a deadline at or before created_at, and a review_at later than expires_at.

review_at.description: When this knowledge claim should be re-reviewed. Null means no review cadence was set.

expires_at.description: After this instant the claim is stale and must not be relied on without re-verification. Null means no expiry was set.
